name: Dragon Empire
background: The Dragon Empire is ruled over by a nobility with the blood and scales of dragons, presiding over innumerable terracotta servants. Their military relies upon the unshakeable determination of their clay warriors to serve as a bulwark while their elite forces strike key points in the enemy line. They will sacrifice anything to earn the approval of their absent Emperor and safeguard his vacant throne until his return.
backgroundFull:
Many in Tyria whisper legends and tales of the Dragon Empire, which is found on the farthest western coast of the vast landmass that is home to their continent. It is said these lands were once a realm of humans ruled over by a horned empress, said to have been granted magical power and wisdom by the lord of the dragon spirits. Whenever the land was in crisis, the soul would be reborn to guide the land’s people to prosperity. 

A cycle emerged, as every incarnation would bring about prosperity, only for the land to fall once more into decline after they passed, requiring the soul to be reborn once more. The last of this line turned to drastic measures, seeking a path to immortality shortly after being crowned Emperor. To attain this, he betrayed the spirits of the land and drained their essence into a potion; as he did, his human form changed to a clay shell, and he emerged with a new draconic body. 

Using his newfound powers, he flew into the sky, opened a Voidgate and passed through it. As he did, a terrible storm came upon the land, transforming his people. Those who shared his blood were partially transformed, their faces twisting to resemble dragons, and their skin replaced with scales. Most, however, simply became one with the terracotta, unbending in both mind and body.

His newly changed people flocked to the capital for guidance but found none. Instead, they found his last edict: a note which declared his people unworthy of him and said that he had chosen to leave them. The now-draconic nobles mourned his loss and decided that they would leave his throne vacant until they could once more prove themselves worthy of him.

Though over a century has now passed since the disappearance of the Dragon Emperor with no sign of his return, the Dragonkin strive to rule over their land as it was before their transformation. Terracotta peasants walk through the streets, carrying out what duties that they once had in life as their rulers strive to maintain the order and beauty that once reigned over their land, without the aid of the Emperor or spirits they once lived alongside. Yet with each passing year, new cracks begin to form in the clay bodies of the labourers, the Emperor’s throne grows colder, and memories of their lost golden age pass farther into memory.

How will you prove yourself worthy of the lost Dragon Emperor?

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Quick Throw
specialRules.description: This model may always target enemies that are not in line of sight when shooting with Indirect weapons (instead of only when using Hold actions).

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Rapid Rush
specialRules.description: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting
specialRules.description: This model gets Bane when shooting.

specialRules.name: Royal Warrior
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Royal Warrior Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Royal Warrior. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Royal Warrior
specialRules.description: If this model has Royal Warrior, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Royal Warrior (instead of only on 6).

specialRules.name: Re-Deployment
specialRules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Brace in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Brace(1) in melee.

specialRules.name: Demolish
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Shielded Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shielded. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Vengeance
specialRules.description: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance tokens on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of tokens on it.

specialRules.name: Predator
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Predator
specialRules.description: If this model has Predator, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Predator (instead of only on 6).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Indirect
specialRules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting enemies over 9" away, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Brace
specialRules.description: Enemies charging this unit get -X total Impact rolls, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
specialRules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
